step1_analysis.description: A passive full-wave rectifier sub-circuit equipped with a Vth-cancellation bias network and Q-modulation switches. It converts an AC input from an inductive coil to a DC voltage while allowing the coil to be shorted for Q-modulation to regulate power or transmit data.

paper_reference.title: A Power-Management ASIC with Q-Modulation Capability for Efficient Inductive Power Transmission

VREC_DC.description: Average rectified DC output voltage under normal operation.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on a 1.8V peak AC input and typical SKY130 Vth drops for the diode-connected transistors.

VREC_Ripple.description: Peak-to-peak ripple on the rectified DC output.

sky130_expected.reasoning: With a large 100nF smoothing capacitor (as reported in the paper) and a 10k load at 2MHz, the ripple is extremely small.

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly listed, but total power is 3W

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the load resistance and switching losses of the transistors at 2MHz.

Z_in_large_signal.description: Large-signal input impedance looking into the AC terminals.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper's 10Ω likely refers to the coil resistance or the shorted state impedance. In normal operation with a 10k load, the equivalent large-signal impedance is much higher.

VREC_DC_QMOD.description: Rectified DC voltage when Q-modulation is active (coil shorted).

sky130_expected.calculation: Discharges through load. With 100nF and 10k, tau=1ms. In 1ms, it drops to ~36% of its initial value.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Q-modulation shorts the input, cutting off power transfer and causing the output capacitor to discharge.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench to measure rectified DC voltage, ripple, power conversion efficiency, input impedance, and the effect of Q-modulation over a 2ms window.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Rectifier and Q-Modulation Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/libs.tech/ngspice/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N3 N3 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 GND N0 N1 N1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 N0 N1 N1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 N2 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 N0 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 GND N4 N0 N0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N1 N3 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 GND N1 N0 N0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 GND N4 N1 N1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N0 N2 N0 N0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* QMOD Control Signal (0V for 1ms, 1.8V for 1ms)
V_N4 N4 0 pulse(0 1.8 1m 10n 10n 1m 2m)

* AC Source representing the secondary coil (2MHz, 1.8V peak)
V_AC N_AC_src 0 dc 0 sin(0 1.8 2Meg)
E1 N0_src 0 N_AC_src 0 0.5
E2 N1_src 0 N_AC_src 0 -0.5
R1 N0_src N0 10
R2 N1_src N1 10
* DC path to ground for floating nodes
R3 N0 0 1Meg
R4 N1 0 1Meg

* Load (100nF as reported in paper)
Cload N3 0 100n
Rload N3 0 10k

.control
  * Run transient analysis for 2ms to capture both normal and QMOD states
  tran 10n 2m
  
  * Define instantaneous power and currents
  let i_coil_tran = (v(N0_src)-v(N0))/10
  let v_diff = v(N0)-v(N1)
  let p_in_inst = v_diff * i_coil_tran
  let p_out_inst = v(N3)*v(N3)/10000
  
  * Measure metrics during normal operation (0.5ms to 1ms)
  meas tran VREC_DC avg v(N3) from=0.5m to=1m
  meas tran VREC_Ripple pp v(N3) from=0.5m to=1m
  meas tran P_IN avg p_in_inst from=0.5m to=1m
  meas tran P_OUT avg p_out_inst from=0.5m to=1m
  
  * Measure RMS values for large-signal impedance
  meas tran V_IN_RMS rms v_diff from=0.5m to=1m
  meas tran I_IN_RMS rms i_coil_tran from=0.5m to=1m
  
  * Measure metrics during QMOD active state (1.5ms to 2ms)
  meas tran VREC_DC_QMOD avg v(N3) from=1.5m to=2m
  
  * Calculate derived metrics
  let PCE = P_OUT / P_IN
  let Z_in_large_signal = V_IN_RMS / I_IN_RMS
  
  print PCE Z_in_large_signal
  quit
.endc
.end
